scope: Isolated loopback Go endpoint and production Snoot UI in WebKit; 10,000 synthetic unsealed events in one branch.
measurement: View-worker elapsed time, including local predicate matching and aggregate preparation; excludes bootstrap and UI painting. Server time is handler wall time. Two isolated runs, each with a first search and unchanged refresh; the second also includes a new ingress event; not a pre-framework comparison or WAN benchmark.
